summary: Public projects created on 14 August 2026: 4 repos.
intro: Four repositories cover personal mental health work with Claude Code, including a template index, a persistent context plugin, and a workspace for one bounded issue. A fourth documents routing a foot pedal to several dictation engines on KDE Wayland.

projects.name: Claude Personal Context Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: builds and maintains a persistent, portable background context layer — intake interview, ingestion of existing material, gap analysis, scoped retrieval, maintenance, export.

projects.name: Claude Therapy Workspace Template
projects.description: GitHub template for working through one bounded personal issue with Claude Code — sessions, threads, timelines and a handover for a real appointment.
